verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own marketplace pages list very large and growing catalogs: 334,081 published Skills, more than 100k MCP servers ranked by activity, and more than 311k community Agents. Counts rise across snapshots (MCP 100,833 → 112,511; Agents 311,770 → 317,516), and there is first-party tooling to publish and version listings via CLI, plus community discover/remix flows. All of this is vendor-reported, and maintainer activity is only implied by activity rankings and versioning, not shown directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of ecosystem health and listing quality, direct evidence of active maintainer engagement (update cadence, maintenance stats).
